content: School Holidays from 20/07 until 04/09 inclusive: Route 1A Inbound departure at 08:30 from St. Clements School will not operate. This departure is operating on School Days only.
Route 3 will only depart from the Station at 07:52 during school days and at 08:02 ONLY during school holidays.
School Holidays from 20/07 until 04/09 inclusive: Route 2 Inbound departure at 08:25 from Grouville Station will not operate. This departure is operating on School Days only.
ROUTE 9 -> DURING SCHOOL HOLIDAYS, BUSES MAY CALL AT INBOUND STOPS UP TO 10 MINUTES EARLY DUE TO TRAFFIC VOLUMES FOR THE 07:48, 08:18 AND 08:34 INBOUND DEPARTURES FROM FIRST TOWER E BUS STOP.

From the 19th of August until the 21st of August, Section 3B of the Bagatelle Road diversion will be taking place, affecting the Route 3.

Expect approximately 10 minute delays.

Passengers are advised that the following bus stops are temporarily suspended. Where an alternative stop is listed, passengers should use that stop until normal service resumes.

Northbound / Outbound

St Saviours School N Stop ID: 3836. Please use Five Oaks N as the nearest available stop.

Bagatelle Parade N Stop ID: 2943. Please use Five Oaks N as the nearest available stop.


Southbound / Inbound

St Saviours School S Stop ID: 3529. Please use Five Oaks S as the nearest available stop.

Bagatelle Parade S Stop ID: 3267. Please use Five Oaks S as the nearest available stop.

ROUTE 15 -> DURING SCHOOL HOLIDAYS, BUSES MAY CALL AT INBOUND STOPS UP TO 10 MINUTES EARLY DUE TO TRAFFIC VOLUMES FOR THE 07:38, 07:53, 08:08, 08:16, 08:28, 08:45 AND 09:00 INBOUND DEPARTURES FROM BEAUMONT E BUS STOP.

La Grande Route de St. Jean Closed

From 08:00 on Monday, the 27th of April, La Grande Route de St. Jean will be closed in sections until February 2027.

Routes 5 and 5A will be affected

PLEASE SEE THE MAP OF THE DIVERSION ON THE PAGE

Route 5 / 5A - OUTBOUND - 

 -> will divert via Clarke Avenue, La Grande Route du Mont a l’Abbe, Rue de Maupertuis, Rue de Haut de L'orme, Rue du Douet, La Rue des Houguettes, and carry on along its usual journey

Route 5 / 5A - INBOUND - 

-> Will go down La Grande Route de St Jean up to Macpela Cemetry (just before Sion Garage), where it will turn right onto> La Rue des Servais, then Route du Mont Cochon and then continue down towards Liberation Station

SHUTTLE BUS INFO:

->  For passengers who will be missed by the Mont Cochon Diversion, a shuttle service will be running southbound starting at Mont a l’Abbe school,  then down to Liberation Station along its usual route. THIS WILL FOLLOW THE REGULAR ROUTE 5 INBOUND TIMETABLE.

-> If the shuttle is too far of a walk from your house. We recommend catching the outbound Route 5 to St. John and remaining on the bus as it turns around and heads inbound to Liberation Station

Langley Park Closed
From 08:00 20th July until 17:00 on Friday 4th September, we will have no access to Langley Park / Langley Avenue. 

Routes affected are as follows:

Route 13 - We will not be able to operate via Langley Park / Avenue on the outbound journey therefore this route will divert up St Saviour's Hill Monday to Saturday.  The route will miss out all stops from Robin Hood Pub - Langley Avenue. Sundays the route will divert both on the outward and inward journey along St Saviour Hill.

Route 21 - We will not be able to travel down Langley Avenue on the inbound journey therefore the route will travel along St Saviour Hill and will also miss out all stops between Langley Avenue and Robin Hood Pub. 

Route 24 remains uaffected and we suggest customers familarise themselves with these times and use as an altenative service.

La Grande Route de St Pierre Closed

From 08:00 on Friday, the 31st of July, until 17:00 on the 26th of August, La Grande Route de St Pierre will be closed again. The Previous diversion will be back up for that duration.


Northbound / Outbound buses will divert via Rue de l'Eglise and Rue de la Pointe, and follow the usual route.

Southbound / Inbound Buses will divert via Grande Route des Augerez, Les Routeurs, La Rue des Sapins, Rue de la Hague, La Route du Manoir, and then continue along its usual journey

Map can be viewed on our diversions page

Salisbury Crescent Closed

The layby and bus stop near Salisbury Crescent will be closed from 07:30 on Monday 17th August until 13:00 on Saturday the 22nd of August.

Temporary stop will be put in place just past the crossing towards Stopford Road

Gorey Fete

From Thursday the 20th of August until 12:30 on the 22nd of August, Buses won't have access to Gorey. Routes 1, 1A, 1G, 2, and 13 will be affected.

Routes 1, 1A, 1G will turn around at Gorey village

Route 13 will miss Gorey Pier but will  continue to St. Catherine

Route 2 will will turn around at Gorey Village and miss St. Catherines entirely (Use Route 13 instead)

Closed Bus Stops include:

- Long Beach

- Clos du Rivage

- Les Residences

- Gorey Pier

Go to our diversions page for a map of the diversion
